semantics.note: The normalisation faithfully isolates the historical parenthetical. The surrounding condition about continuing trends governs the competitive forecast, not this observation.

contract.note: Aggregate commercial profitability is a fair ordinary reading. Considering results through the statement date preserves the historical scope. Industry-wide versus individual-provider profitability affects the result; the contract appropriately leaves unspecified accounting choices unresolved.

evidence.note: Published before the cutoff and reports historical OpenAI net losses. One company's 2024 results cannot establish cumulative industry profitability; its 2025 results extend beyond the target period.

The filing was available before the cutoff. Anthropic discloses historical net losses, but this company disclosure does not establish industry-wide results. Later-period losses fall outside the target period.

The founder's contemporaneous profitability statement is relevant counterevidence to a universal-provider reading. It supplies neither a defined net-income measure nor evidence of aggregate profitability and remains a company disclosure.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes reported losses at selected providers and a profitability assertion from another. It lacks comparable industry-wide net-income records covering results through May 14, 2025, including prior profitability. Neither aggregate profitability nor its absence is established. The speculative characterization supplies no separate measurable test.
